startup_file.what: Founded in 2018 by aerospace engineers Gurushankara KC, Abhinav Alva and Chetan Kumar. Develops small gas turbine engines (20 kgf to 400 kgf thrust) for aerial platforms and energy systems, with the design, assembly and testing pipeline and its engine control unit built in-house.
